clients.person.forget.ask: Chausar deletes everything it keeps about them: their sources, how you know them, their paths, pipeline cards and drafts. Where Chausar can keep a one-way check of their email, phone and LinkedIn address, a file you import later leaves them out; it tells you if it couldn't. Backups made before now still hold them until those backups are deleted. Records the law needs, such as a client's invoices, stay. This can't be undone.
